heard: Deep Space is vibrating with an eerie hum. Voyager 1 heard it after crossing the border in 2012, but space is supposed to be a silent vacuum. The probe's main sensor had been dead since 1980. Scientists had to wait for a solar eruption to hit. The blast shook the plasma surrounding the ship. It revealed gas much denser than inside our solar system. Now that we know the void has its own persistent soundtrack, it's the constant buzzing of our entire galaxy. Even in the dark, Deep Space is vibrating.
